questions.question: What sign did Ezekiel perform with baggage in chapter 12?
options: Built a small model of the whole temple out of river clay and gathered stones
Prepared an exile's baggage and dug through the wall, as a sign of coming exile
Burned up all of his belongings before the watching people gathered in the square
Wore a very heavy wooden yoke through the crowded streets of the whole city
questions.answer: Prepared an exile's baggage and dug through the wall, as a sign of coming exile

questions.question: What did this sign represent?
options: The prince and people of Jerusalem going into exile
The coming of a deliverer to free the people
The rebuilding of the ruined city walls
The return of the exiles after seventy years
questions.answer: The prince and people of Jerusalem going into exile

questions.question: God said no longer would the people say the proverb that visions come to nothing, for the words would be fulfilled.
I am a _____ for you; as I have done, so shall it be done to them.
None of My words will be delayed any longer; the message I speak will be _____.
